change.title: pr-37429-flat
change.description: Add HTML sanitizer for translated message resources
change.author: Cristian Sotomayor

findings.title: JS-side message switched from i18next `{{n}}` to MessageFormat `{n}` and a `choice` format: renders raw in the UI
findings.body: account-ui formats messages with i18next (`js/apps/account-ui/src/i18n.ts:25-29`, default `{{x}}` interpolation). Server validation errors are passed as `{0: .., 1: .., 2: ..}` params to `t()` in `js/libs/ui-shared/src/user-profile/utils.ts:74-86`. Every other key in this file uses `{{0}}`, and every other locale's `error-invalid-multivalued-size` in `js/apps/*/maven-resources-community` still uses `{{0}}`/`{{1}}`/`{{2}}`. With `{0}` and `{2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}`, i18next does not interpolate. Users will see the literal text `Attribute {0} must have at least {1} and at most {2} {2,choice,...}.` The English text is also the fallback for every locale without a translation. The `choice` syntax is a `java.text.MessageFormat` feature that i18next does not support. The original line (`{{0}} ... value(s)`) did not trigger the new verifier, so there was no need to change it. Revert this line to the `{{n}}` form with `value(s)`.

findings.title: Same i18next/MessageFormat mismatch in admin-ui English bundle
findings.body: admin-ui also interpolates with i18next (`js/apps/admin-ui/src/i18n/i18n.ts:13-17`), and this file's neighbouring keys (e.g. lines 2989-2997) use `{{0}}`. `{0}` and `{2,choice,...}` will be shown verbatim in the admin console's user-profile validation error. Revert to `Attribute {{0}} must have at least {{1}} and at most {{2}} value(s).`. The change belongs only in `themes/src/main/resources/theme/base/{login,admin}/messages_en.properties`, which the server formats with MessageFormat; `MultiValueValidator` passes `Long` min/max (`services/.../MultiValueValidator.java:137`), which ChoiceFormat accepts.

findings.title: Lithuanian `totpStep1` replaced with Italian text
findings.body: The new value `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:` is Italian (it matches `messages_it.properties:138`, `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo dispositivo mobile`). Lithuanian users will see an Italian sentence in the OTP setup. Translate it into Lithuanian. If no translation is available, remove the key so it falls back to English. The same text is used for `loginTotpStep1` in `login/messages/messages_lt.properties:71`.

findings.title: Lithuanian `loginTotpStep1` replaced with Italian text
findings.body: `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:` is Italian, not Lithuanian. It will be shown on the login-theme TOTP setup page for the `lt` locale. Use a Lithuanian translation, or drop the key so it falls back to English.

findings.title: Simplified Chinese file now contains Traditional Chinese `totpStep1`
findings.body: `在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：` uses Traditional characters (手機, 安裝, 應用程式) in the zh_CN bundle. The neighbouring lines (113-114) and `login/messages/messages_zh_CN.properties:123` are Simplified (e.g. `在您的移动设备中安装以下任意一个应用：`). Replace it with a Simplified version, e.g. `在您的手机上安装以下应用之一：`.

findings.title: English-file lookup is derived by regex on the absolute path, and failures are unchecked exceptions
findings.body: The English counterpart is found by applying `replaceAll("resources-community","resources")` and `replaceAll("_[a-zA-Z-_]*\\.properties", ...)` to the whole absolute path. `Z-_` inside the character class is a range that happens to include `[ \ ] ^ _`, so the regex works by accident. Both replacements also apply to any directory in the checkout path. A missing English file (for example a community-only theme) gives a bare `RuntimeException` from `verifySafeHtml`, not a `MojoExecutionException` naming the problem. Consider deriving the sibling with `file.toPath().resolveSibling(...)` and only substituting the locale suffix of the file name. The same applies to `file.getAbsolutePath().contains("email")` at line 132, which matches any parent directory called `*email*` (use the parent folder name).

findings.title: Non-static, constant-style fields; unused parameter; typo
findings.body: `POLICY_SOME_HTML`, `POLICY_NO_HTML` and `HTML_TAGS` are instance fields named like constants. They are rebuilt for every file, because the Mojo creates a new `VerifyMessageProperties` per file (`ThemeVerifierMojo.java:51`). Make them `private static final`. `santizeAnchors` is misspelled and its `key` parameter is unused; use it in the message instead, because `Didn't find anchor tag X in original string` (line 157) gives neither key nor file. `<scope>compile</scope>` on commons-text in `pom.xml:84` is the default.

findings.title: No positive test and no coverage of the special cases
findings.body:
All four tests only assert that an error is reported. Nothing asserts that valid input passes: HTML that the English source allows, the `
` form, anchors identical to English, or the `templateHelp` / `choice` / email-RTL normalisations. A regression that flags every key would still pass. It is also untested that the `resources-community` to `resources` mapping finds the English file. Add at least one fixture that must produce an empty list.

contracts.action: Theme verifier now sanitizes every message value against the English source's HTML policy and fails the Maven build on a mismatch
contracts.equivalent_path: verifyNoDuplicateKeys in the same class, run from ThemeVerifierMojo.execute over every messages_*.properties in the module's resources
contracts.before_after: Before, only duplicate keys were checked. Now each file is also parsed with PropertyResourceBundle and its English sibling is located. Anchors that equal the English ones are stripped, then OWASP sanitize is applied (the SOME_HTML policy only if the English value has a tag, otherwise NO_HTML), and the result is compared with the value. Any difference is added to messages, and the Mojo throws MojoFailureException.
contracts.visible_effect: Build-time only. A bad translation fails the themes and js module builds with 'Illegal HTML in key ...'. The message-file edits in this PR exist to make existing files pass.
contracts.failure_mode: A missing or unreadable English sibling throws an unchecked RuntimeException, not MojoExecutionException. This is acceptable for a build tool but gives a poor message. Patterns with `<` that are not special-cased fail the build.

contracts.action: The error-invalid-multivalued-size message was changed in server-side (MessageFormat) and JS-side (i18next) bundles to the same `{n}` + `{2,choice,...}` syntax
contracts.equivalent_path: Other keys in the same JS bundles and other locales' error-invalid-multivalued-size use `{{n}}`. Params are supplied by setUserProfileServerError to i18next t().
contracts.before_after: Before, the JS bundles used `{{0}}..{{2}} value(s)` and interpolated. Now they use `{0}`, `{1}`, `{2}` and a `choice` expression that i18next cannot interpret.
contracts.visible_effect: Account console and admin console user-profile validation errors show raw `{0}`/`{1}`/`{2}` and the choice expression in English, the fallback language.
contracts.failure_mode: Silent wrong text, no error. The server-side bundles (themes/.../messages_en) are correct because MultiValueValidator passes Long arguments to MessageFormat.

summary: The verifier logic and its four tests look sound and the many HTML fixes in the translations are correct. I found two kinds of defect, all in the message files. First, the `error-invalid-multivalued-size` edits in the account-ui and admin-ui English bundles switch from i18next `{{n}}` to MessageFormat `{n}` plus a `choice` expression. i18next won't interpolate that, so users will see raw placeholders; both lines should be reverted. Second, the Lithuanian `totpStep1` and `loginTotpStep1` text is Italian, and the zh_CN account `totpStep1` is in Traditional Chinese. I also left a few smaller suggestions on the verifier (static fields, path handling, missing positive test). I only read the code and ran nothing.
